reading.zh: 先读「上传策略」看三档限额与格式三重判断（真源 forms.md §1.4 / enums.md §12.1-12.2），再看「补件轮次」理解 round 的判定，然后看「私有存储与鉴权下载」理解落盘布局与数据域，最后看「附件删除与三态窗口」理解删除的两条闸门与元数据/文件的一致取舍。
reading.en: Start with Upload Policy for the three limits and the three-way format check (forms.md 1.4 / enums.md 12.1-12.2), then Round Marking for how round is derived, then Private Storage & Authorized Download for the on-disk layout and data scope, and finally Attachment Deletion Guard for the two delete gates and the metadata/file consistency tradeoff.
